description: AGSC-01-39: the SKOS import maps a thesaurus to items. Derivation over the Turtle file below, with i18n.default en and the operator human:tester. The scheme becomes the cluster taxonomy, titled by its prefLabel. The concept Animal becomes the concept animal of kind term: title from the English prefLabel, aliases [Creature] from the altLabel, description from the definition (77 code points, inside 40 to 200), clusters [taxonomy] from inScheme and topConceptOf, narrower [cat], one source from dcterms:source, and its own IRI kept in x-skos-iri. The concept Cat becomes cat: its definition has 15 code points, outside 40 to 200, so it is written as the first paragraph of the body, no description is written, and that is one warning; broader [animal]. Every item is status draft with prov {origin imported, operator human:tester}, one warning each, so four AGSC-E506 warnings in all (three drafts, one definition in the body) and no error. Items are given as parsed frontmatter and body text, in slug order.

frontmatter.description: A living organism that feeds on organic matter and can move by its own means.
